name: Semjénháza (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Semjénháza (a quartered red and white checky, green and blue shield with a tree and a church) between the names SEMJÉNHÁZA above and PUSTARA below in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
